product: Bookkeeping automation for independent restaurants: receipts photographed, matched to bank lines nightly, month-end in a day. Different: built for multi-site owners, French VAT rules for food, no accountant needed for the monthly close.
customers: Owners of two to five restaurants in France. Before: an accountant plus spreadsheets. Switched when the second site opened and the close took a week. Churned: single-site owners who found it too much.
competitors: Pennylane (all-in-one for SMEs), the accountant's own portal, Excel
